solver_sql: WITH s1 AS (SELECT cs.raceId AS raceId, c.country AS country, AVG(cs.points) AS p, AVG(cs.wins) AS w FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY cs.raceId, c.country), s2 AS (SELECT country, AVG(p) AS p, AVG(w) AS w FROM s1 GROUP BY country), s3 AS (SELECT AVG(p) AS b FROM s2) SELECT s2.country, s2.p, s2.w, s2.p - s3.b FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.b IS NOT NULL

WITH s1 AS (SELECT driverId AS d, SUM(points) AS p FROM results GROUP BY driverId), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(p) AS t FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.d AS d, s1.p AS p, s1.p * 1.0 / NULLIF(s2.t, 0) AS sh FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.t IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(sh) AS a FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.d AS d, s3.p AS p, s3.sh AS sh, s3.sh - s4.a AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.p > s4.a) SELECT AVG(p), AVG(sh), AVG(diff) FROM s5
